issue.title: Align Expo SDK 57 package versions so Quality Gates pass
issue.body:
## Problem

Quality Gates CI (`expo-doctor` and `npx expo install --check`) is failing on recent PRs because Expo SDK 57-managed packages on `main` have drifted from the versions Expo currently expects. Feature PRs (e.g. #341) applied `npx expo install --fix` as a side fix, but those PRs have not merged, so every new PR still fails the alignment gates.

## Goal

Land a **deps-only** PR so `npx expo install --check` and `npm run doctor` pass on `main` again. Do not mix this with product work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npx expo install --fix` applied from current `main` (SDK 57 compatible versions only).
- [ ] `npx expo install --check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run doctor` (`expo-doctor`) passes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test -- --ci` pass.
- [ ] Change set is limited to `package.json` / `package-lock.json` (and lockfile-adjacent metadata if Expo rewrites it). No product/feature code.

## Notes

- Android-only; do not add iOS config.
- After merge, other open PRs should rebase onto `main` so they can drop duplicate `expo install --fix` commits.
